verdict.rationale: QuickBooks Payroll clearly pays W-2 employees, with same-day or next-day direct deposit, auto payroll, and W-2 access (docs-5, -6, -9, -13). On the contractor side, the evidence only shows unlimited 1099-MISC/NEC e-filing with copies sent to contractors (docs-7), not actually paying contractors. So the single-platform coverage of both worker types is only partly evidenced. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of contractor payments (direct deposit or payouts to 1099 workers) from the same platform, and independent or hands-on corroboration of mixed W-2/1099 pay runs.
